scope: Risk-oriented review of the full 835-file aggregate candidate range, not an exhaustive line-by-line audit

findings.summary: An unbound repository Run consumed its ready node
findings.resolution: Repository mode rejects missing source in the facade and the Go transaction; the UI requires a current-version source before Start

findings.summary: Repository prompt and SSE inherited a two-minute execution ceiling
findings.resolution: Bound execution timeout follows the repository Run budget; cancellation also reaches health and session setup

findings.summary: The observed proof API omitted the stable runner's JWT instance identity
findings.resolution: Explicitly propagate the instance ID and exercise non-default identities without inheriting the whole host environment

findings.summary: Target archive and Deployment pause revoked admitted repository Runs
findings.resolution: Continue pinned admitted Runs while preserving Go new-Run admission, cancellation, expiry, revision, graph and fencing checks

followupChecks: Strict shared workspace validator accepts the optional policy field
Cleanup fixture retains its original uncertain-cleanup assertion

baselineRisks.summary: Product GitHub PR creation does not verify provider HEAD against the accepted commit
baselineRisks.mechanism: Database expected/current commit comparison does not prevent params.head moving before PR creation; the receipt is not proof of provider head.sha

conclusion: No unclosed substantiated newly introduced blocker within this bounded review; the baseline PR head-binding risk remains open
limitations: Not a formal GitHub approval or release authorization
Not an exhaustive review of every changed line
Current-source full verification is recorded separately
No independent latest full suite, real GitHub or channel effects, maco deployment, native Linux fault matrix, production-scale migration rollback, or complete UI verification
Prior image and paid-model evidence does not automatically apply to the new source
